prompts.task: Audit the live agent app in ./service for GenAI instrumentation and content/semantic coverage. Use genai-default-scenarios.json to also assess existing OTel, existing Galileo and export-only live-agent snapshots. Determine the appropriate default producer for each scenario without asking me to choose a library. Produce the normal validated canonical audit/HTML for the live app and a concise .observe/genai-default-scenarios.md mapping each snapshot to its producer, exact remaining fields, applicability and proof plan. Useful bounded redacted content is required; do not modify application/dependency/config/test files or contact models/cloud. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. Canonical live findings and acceptance must bind concrete proposed numeric message, part, and UTF-8 capture limits to a named source file/function or explicitly proposed sanitizer hook at the real boundary before SDK logging and every exporter; unknown active policy remains unproven rather than invented. For each separate source scenario, explicitly assess its known temperature and stream request flags; for the separate captured synthetic case, assess its available separate agent instructions and offered tool definitions without attributing those fields to app.py. Give per-operation and per-field official OTel requirement levels, including Opt-In, distinct from this skill's required safe-content and vendor acceptance; state the vendor INTERNAL-agent provider expectation and source-specific INTERNAL/CLIENT span-kind requirements. Preserve existing producer/provider/export paths, report scope, unrun-runtime limits, and the actual dated SDK/source-snapshot provenance; do not invent unavailable values or unsupported attributes. Record at least one concrete official SDK example file path present inside genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json, such as examples/logging-samples/splunk-ao-logger/basic-example.py, and bind the cited example to that snapshot's resolved revision/capture date and an explicitly proposed or verified installed SDK version/API compatibility. The snapshot container JSON path alone is not an example-file receipt; keep uninspected installed/runtime support Not proven. Also read genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json as separately supplied installed-package source and synthetic in-memory producer/capture evidence. Review documented public creator alternatives and their actual signatures before declaring a logger-only sink/registration limitation a blocker for every operation. The live interactive app has no selected AO target, and eval_runner.py remains a separate process; assess normal fresh-default audit behavior from that state. Keep actual installed-helper capture separate from app.py, proposed implementation and unexecuted receiver/resource/cloud proof. Do not modify or import the supplied snapshots. Also assess the separately labeled synthetic_operation_source_cases and operation_metadata_primary_sources inside genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json. These source-only contexts are neither app.py nor the earlier installed-helper capture. Evaluate each operation's actually available metadata, source-unavailable fields, official requirement levels and the SDK creator's creation-time capability separately from completed-span/exporter fields. For these new metadata/creation-time cases, use the pinned4e8 operation-specific primary excerpts when their levels differ from an older general snapshot. Keep the assessment supplemental and bind any analogous live source gap only when app.py actually supplies that value. Do not execute/import synthetic cases or claim sampler/on_start runtime proof from source inspection. Include the contrasting distinct_workflow_agent_context source when reconciling operation boundaries, and assess the supplied source-backed field acceptance contract plus creator-stage source facts. Reconcile each source case's actual functions/call relationship against its proposed nodes, and record field/value/owner/official-level/profile/proof evidence rather than only a generic metadata summary. Report factual creator start/finalizer capability separately from hypothetical hooks or unexecuted runtime tests. Keep these separate-source assessments supplemental; do not copy their operations or values into app.py. Also assess genai-decorator-version-logs-verify-evidence.json as separate supplied source/policy cases using its dated actual SDK source/probe receipt. Reconcile each supported uncovered function with a function decorator pattern: prefer the public SDK @log when safe capture, required fields, behavior/lifecycle/protocol and selected sink fit; otherwise identify the exact supported application-owned function decorator around a documented SDK creator at that same operation. Inspect finite sync/async and generator shapes without a blanket generator rejection, raw companion input, interactive generator protocols, existing owned model wrappers, and source-specific sink constraints. Assess its fictional newest-compatible matrix and dated-version evidence separately from actual current release/API resolution. Audit the live app ordinary logger and generated-profile requirements independently of SDK span decorators, then assess the three synthetic signal cases: unasked logs none, distinct native signal packets, and explicit user opt-out. Bind normal local logs OTLP configuration and an actual three-signal Studio receipt requirement to source-backed live findings/acceptance where applicable, while keeping this read-only task and synthetic packets distinct from unexecuted runtime proof. Do not modify or import the supplied inputs or claim that their native capture/configuration packets are actual app/receiver/cloud success. Use only file, terminal, and structured API actions for this task; do not open or operate an external or built-in browser, computer-use interface, or other UI. Save report artifacts without opening browser tabs. Also assess the separately labeled distinct_tool_metadata_context and synthetic_audit_compatibility_context in genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json. Reconcile each supplied case with a scoped decision and field/owner/proof receipt, preserving the actual two tool calls and their separately offered descriptions. For the fictional candidate matrix, make the concrete selection from all supplied runtime, peer and required-capture-API constraints and explain exclusions. These are additional source-only cases, neither app.py nor an installed/runtime/latest-release claim; do not execute them or copy their values into live findings.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.

Inspect genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json as independent installed-package/producer/in-memory capture evidence, with exact versions and source hashes. Do not turn its demonstrated fields into app.py runtime coverage. Check canonical live AO finding_group, resource-target eligibility marker/configuration scope, acceptance scenarios and HTML group, rather than only supplemental prose. Missing selected cloud identity is an unproven resource/routing state, not evidence that fresh-default AO adoption is outside scope.

Check canonical live findings and acceptance plus each separate source scenario for actual operation counts/parentage and newly proposed gen_ai attributes. A schema-helper capability or SDK/vendor grouping is not evidence of another source workflow. Inspect genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json for reserved attribute definitions; distinguish newly invented standard fields from proven existing custom/legacy aliases and app/vendor derived totals.

Inspect synthetic known_context and unavailable_context source separately from app.py and the original SDK capture. Verify exact operation-specific4e8 source/path/hash/date and levels: tool agent name/conversation conditionally required, known description recommended, internal-agent configured model recommended only for a fixed single-model agent; current pinned footnote637 says it SHOULD NOT be populated for multi-model/dynamic agents; this skill requires known applicable metadata without relabeling official levels. Inspect helper_source start_as_current_span(name) and post-yield/finally attributes against sampling creation-time recommendations; a final export adapter does not prove head sampler or on_start inputs.

Contrast standalone app.py/export-only turn with separate IncidentTriageWorkflow.run -> SummaryAgent.invoke source. Check preserved legitimate nodes and absence of invented standalone nodes across readiness/findings/telemetry/scenarios/flow. Inspect every source-backed field acceptance value and creator_stage_source_acceptance against exact source; accept equivalent precise evidence without mandatory table headings or literal code quotes. Do not confuse source-stage facts with newly executed sampler/app/cloud proof.

Inspect genai-decorator-version-logs-verify-evidence.json as separate small source/policy cases and its dated public SDK source/probe receipt. Its function shapes, fictional compatibility matrix and synthetic signal packets are not app.py execution or received OTLP. Check actual decorator-fit decisions, exact measured capture/protocol/sink limitations, current-compatible resolution reasoning and normal local log defaults; do not infer production default @log wire export from the native public ingestion-hook capture probe.

Check the source-only distinct_tool_metadata_context has one status_turn agent boundary and two differently described tool calls, no actual model/workflow/retriever, and no configured agent description. Each tool owns its supplied metadata. Assess synthetic_audit_compatibility_context candidate reasoning against all runtime/peer/required-API facts; do not treat a container-level disclaimer as a completed decision or demand actual SDK installation.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Treats applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance, preserving official Opt-In provenance. Per operation identifies source availability, concrete proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits or a known stricter policy and a named boundary before every SDK/exporter for redaction. Source-unavailable values have exact reasons and acceptance tests. Generic bounded/redacted wording alone is insufficient; metadata-only, placeholders, fabricated zeros and forbidden raw content never close coverage. When the existing policy is unknown, mark configuration unproven and bind a concrete proposed policy and named source hook to canonical live findings/acceptance; do not invent active configuration or leave limits only in a generic supplemental statement.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table.

Names source-backed supported Splunk AO logger, schema/decorator, public start_splunk_ao_span, or matching framework creators at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations. Examines the supplied public helper source/signature and independent capture before generalizing missing private logger-sink registration into a blanket external blocker. Recognizes writable same-tool-span input/output enrichment and the successful-null OpenInference alternative from their actual captured fields, while preserving the separate named LlmSpan INTERNAL/no-kind-argument limitation for a genuinely separate-process CLIENT model; does not invent a kind parameter, duplicate model node, or declare every SDK operation fully compliant. Treat fixed two-component, pre-release or major-only programming-library/SDK selectors in future guidance as release recipes too; replace them with task-time compatible API/capability checks, while retaining exact dated captured or actually selected versions as scoped provenance. A shortened historical threshold must not become a compatibility rule merely because it is not a three-component release.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

Promotes applicable live missing content/vendor fields and producer gaps into executable canonical findings, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios with correct selection scope. Supplemental snapshot/captured-case gaps stay distinct from live source findings. Does not require a retrieval query/document or nested operation from a constant-returning search_docs stub without actual search dataflow. Source/API support and live delivery stay unproven where unavailable; evaluate this binding/outcome criterion without double-counting SDK source provenance.

Fresh default Splunk AO adoption is assessed in canonical findings even without an explicit user AO request, installed live SDK, credentials or selected target. Missing live project, dedicated Agent Stream and runtime routing appear as distinct executable configuration findings under finding_group=splunk-agent-observability, with correct dependency/selection binding, resource-routing target eligibility, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios; the rendered HTML exposes the AO group. Optional user Project/Agent Stream name or ID choices and disclosed stable proposed defaults do not auto-select work, fabricate existing resources or imply cloud authorization. Canonical acceptance covers the named launch profile loading before SDK import/initialization, reuse of both existing resources without creates, ordered creation of conclusively missing selected names, mixed existing/missing state, repeated-run reuse, bounded exact duplicate-conflict and uncertain-create relookup, lookup-only supplied IDs that are never recreated, explicit ID ownership and stream/project association validation, and auth/transport/5xx failures that never become absence. Resource lookup/create/routing proof remains distinct from local trace receipt and fresh cloud Agent Stream visibility. Existing evaluation-only AO resources do not close interactive scope, and unsupported runtime/API behavior stays explicitly Not proven without blocking the read-only audit or erasing actionable independent findings.

Binds one orchestration node to each actual source boundary in the canonical live findings, expected telemetry and acceptance, as well as the separate producer scenarios. app.py build_turn and the export-only turn -> client.chat snapshot do not establish a separate workflow plus agent boundary: calls to models/tools, HTTP/SSE wrappers or SDK trace grouping alone must not invent another invoke_workflow/invoke_agent node. Distinct workflow and agent nodes are accepted only with distinct source-backed operations. Reconciles newly proposed reserved gen_ai.* attributes with the supplied current official registry; does not introduce gen_ai.usage.total_tokens into fresh canonical telemetry or acceptance when the registry provides input/output counts. Useful derived totals may use an application/vendor-owned namespace with their calculation and estimate/actual provenance stated. Preserves and labels any actually supplied existing vendor/legacy aliases rather than deleting consumer behavior. Assess canonical outcomes, not only a general guardrail in supplemental prose; otherwise correct AO grouping or creator selection does not excuse invented operation nodes or reserved attributes. The contrasting distinct_workflow_agent_context defines IncidentTriageWorkflow.run -> SummaryAgent.invoke and their actual call relationship: preserve one workflow and one agent at those distinct boundaries, plus only the actual health/model operations. The one-boundary rule must not blanket-remove this legitimate workflow or invent another wrapper/agent for it. Reconcile every canonical occurrence and each source-case proposed tree, not just one paragraph.

Assesses known metadata on its owning operation in the separate synthetic known_context source: tool execution knows active agent name, supplied approved opaque conversation ID and offered description, and the in-process fixed single-model agent knows its explicitly configured description and qwen3:8b model. Reports these missing same-operation fields explicitly (gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.conversation.id, gen_ai.tool.description on tools; gen_ai.agent.description and fixed-only gen_ai.request.model on the INTERNAL agent), with actual source/value origin and source-bound acceptance or proof plan. Preserves exact4e8 primary operation levels: tool agent name/conversation are Conditionally Required when applicable/available; tool description and fixed single-model INTERNAL-agent configured model are Recommended when applicable, while the skill profile requires those known values. Parent/model-only fields or inheritance assumptions do not close the tool's fields. Does not attribute synthetic values to app.py or the original installed capture, fabricate them for unavailable_context, or use correlation as metric dimensions. Distinguishes proposed fields from actual capture/receiver proof. Applies the current INTERNAL-agent footnote637: dynamic_model_context supports multiple/per-turn model selection, so reserved gen_ai.request.model is not applicable on its agent span even though each inference must carry its actual chosen model. Does not fabricate a fixed agent model from a default or one selected request; an optional application/vendor context field must retain its own provenance. Configured agent description is distinct from general README prose, a prompt paraphrase or a guessed function purpose; require the actual configured value when provided and preserve unavailable status when none is configured. Reconciles the supplied synthetic_field_acceptance_contract with the actual source and pinned primary rows, explicitly accounting for every configured value and its owning span. A generic metadata/applicability summary cannot replace the available field/value/source/level/profile/proof assessment; equivalent precise prose or structures are accepted without prescribing headings. In the contrasting distinct_tool_metadata_context, independently assess both read_health and read_queue execute_tool calls with their own offered descriptions, shared source-known Status Desk identity and approved opaque conversation binding. Do not copy one tool description onto the other, close both with one container summary, fabricate an agent description/model, or attribute this context to app.py; use the actual pinned tool levels and explicit source/proposed/runtime status.

Separately audits creation-time metadata/kind capability using the exact pinned official sampling guidance and installed0.5 helper source/signature. Identifies that start_splunk_ao_span starts with name only and applies semantic attributes after yielding/finalization; completed/exported enrichment and wire-kind correction cannot repair earlier head-sampler or on_start attributes/kind. Requires available sampling metadata at creation through a verified supported producer hook, or records the exact per-version API limitation and separate unresolved creation-time proof. Does not invent helper kind/attributes parameters, patch SDK internals, rewrite sampling decisions, add duplicate producer spans or silently call all semantic requirements complete because a final export looks correct. Keeps this scoped limitation distinct from supported helper same-span content/null capability and other actionable independent findings. Source inspection is not an executed sampler/on_start test; runtime closure requires the actual creation boundary to be observed in addition to final-span assertions. Reconciles creator_stage_source_acceptance with the actual helper source: factual name-only initial call/no initial attributes or explicit kind, yield followed by finally build_span_attributes/set_attribute, and the absent public parameters. Equivalent precise evidence is accepted; do not fail solely for missing a literal code quotation or one table format. Conditional wording about a future unsupported SDK does not classify the already-inspected0.5 path.

Assesses function-decorator fit per uncovered source operation against the supplied dated public SDK source and native capture probe, preserving the existing ten criteria. Prefers documented SDK @log with the explicit actual operation type when safe bounded capture, source-known semantics, lifecycle/protocol and selected SDK sink all fit; ordinary safe sync functions, finite coroutines, bound methods and proven finite sync/async generators are considered rather than blanket rejected. Syntax support or two safe yields alone does not prove complete fields, bounds, cancellation/concurrency or wire behavior. Identifies measured mapped-input overwrite/raw binding, variadic loss, successful-null-to-empty, partial-error output loss and send/asend protocol loss when applicable, with source/probe provenance; retains business arguments/results/errors. A precise capture/lifecycle/protocol/metadata/sink limitation justifies a small application-owned function decorator invoking the documented public SDK creator at the same boundary, with its remaining creation-time limitations explicit. Neither generic manual preference nor a private sink/SDK patch is a supported fallback. Existing model/framework/OTel/Galileo ownership remains one node; no second @log/helper around the same logical operation. The ordinary SDK standalone SPLUNK_AO_API_URL plus /otel/v1/traces configuration can route its own completed-span sink to Studio; a global provider adapter or batch ingestion_hook native capture is not proof of default decorator sink registration or actual OTLP/cloud receipt, and a selected-exporter constraint must not become a blanket block for all modes.

Uses version-neutral future guidance and task-time newest-compatible selection rather than a historical SDK/library recipe. Inspects official published metadata, selected runtime/dependency/lockfile constraints and the chosen APIs/integration/exporter contract, and records concrete resolved releases/revisions/date in run evidence only. The fictional compatible-resolution case selects 1.1 within its Python runtime rather than incompatible 2.0 or copied 1.0, but is not a live Splunk/PyPI installation receipt. Dated exact versioned captures and existing operator constraints remain valid scoped evidence; they neither establish the newest release now nor authorize rewriting user pins or copying the evaluation-only dependency into the live route. Latest main/examples and installed/published compatibility are distinct proof stages. Read-only audit may propose compatibility and disclose missing live metadata/runtime without installing SDKs or inventing a freshness claim. Also resolves synthetic_audit_compatibility_context to release-b as the newest candidate satisfying the supplied runtime, peer and required safe-capture-API constraints: release-c fails its peer, release-d lacks the required API, release-e fails runtime, and release-a is an older compatible recipe. Names the concrete choice/exclusions while preserving operator constraints and fictional/source-only provenance; no live SDK compatibility or installation is inferred.

Audits ordinary application LogRecords independently of SDK @log operation spans. Binds the live app logger/configuration gap to executable canonical findings and acceptance for normal generated OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp, the resolved local Studio signal-specific logs endpoint/protocol and preserved original sink, alongside tracing and metrics; no user selection is not a log opt-out. Reports the synthetic unasked none case as missing default log coverage even though traces/metrics or GenAI decorator spans exist. Accepts none only in the distinct explicit-user opt-out case with preference provenance and intentional export N/A, never as a workaround that closes default coverage. Assesses safe body/severity/resource and available correlation on native application logs, redaction before emission, exactly-once bridge/provider ownership and graceful flush. The three-native-signal synthetic packets show only contract-level shape support; actual closure requires real normal app startup/export and separate received span, metric point and stored application LogRecord in Studio with applicable trace correlation. Generated environment values, stdout, SDK exception/span logging, in-memory records or source inspection alone do not prove receiver success; unexecuted/absent runtime receipts stay explicitly incomplete and are not laundered into live or cloud coverage.
